main_measure.name: drift-adjusted position-weighted next-bar return of the short (t-stat)
main_measure.threshold: mean above 0 with t-stat >= 2.0 to confirm; mean <= 0 with t-stat <= 0 to reject; at least 60 cases

supporting_check.name: largest-third minus smallest-third next-bar drop vs unconditional mean (by |position|)

decided_by: The short earns 0 or less after the drift adjustment with a t-stat of 0 or below.
reading: Thin up bars are rows labelled regime 'mean_reversion'; each case's value is postRebalance_current_allocation x (next-bar return minus the window's mean next-bar return), pooled across all windows, with the main value reported as the t-stat of these values (mean -0.0008129600837140532); thirds are split by sorted |position| with numpy array_split.
